title: Clipboard's search bar should be Right-Clickable for pasting texts
line: Right-clicking the clipboard's search field now opens a menu with Paste, Copy, Cut, Undo and Select All, both in the tray popup and in the Meta+V popup.
explanation: Plasma's text fields (PlasmaComponents3 TextField, which the clipboard's SearchField is built on) had no context menu, so right-clicking did nothing. Open libplasma MR !1576 adds one to every Plasma text field. With only the MR, the menu works in the tray clipboard popup and Kickoff, but in the Meta+V clipboard popup the right-click closes the whole popup, because KlipperPopup hides itself whenever focus moves to any other window, including the menu's own popup window. The plasma-workspace commit makes KlipperPopup ignore focus moving to windows that are transient for it.

commits.message:
declarativeimports/plasmacomponents3: add TextField context menu

Plasma's TextFields don't have a context menu. This makes it hard to
paste without using keyboard shortcuts, and to use other common editing
actions (though those should be less rare).

Luckily we already have implementations in Union and qqc2-desktop-style,
which we can be heavily inspired by. More specifically, we use union's
much simpler method of loading the context menu, and desktop style's
menu contents, but remove much of the complexity and in particular the
spell checking, as this is likely rarely useful in Plasma, so we end up
with a relatively compact and understandable implementation that works
well for the most common uses: seach fields and password fields.

BUG: 525065
BUG: 525063
BUG: 524291

klipper: keep popup open when focus moves to its own child windows

The clipboard popup hid itself whenever focus left it, including when
focus moved to a menu opened from it, such as a text field context menu.
It now stays open while the focused window is transient for the popup.

BUG: 525065

media.caption: Tray clipboard, master: right-clicking the search field shows only a tooltip, no menu
Tray clipboard with the MR: right-click opens Undo/Redo/Cut/Copy/Paste/Delete/Select All
Meta+V clipboard popup, master: no menu on right-click
Meta+V clipboard popup with the MR plus the klipper fix: the menu opens and the popup stays

review.text: The plasma-workspace fix in KlipperPopup::onFocusWindowChanged (walking transientParent() so opening a child menu does not hide the Meta+V popup) is clean and necessary alongside libplasma MR !1576. However, the libplasma patch has maintainer-blocking i18n and QML Action issues (using qsTr instead of KI18n in libplasma, leaving T.Action shortcuts enabled separately from MenuItem.enabled, and leaving Select All enabled on empty fields). Additionally, the plasma-workspace commit should use CCBUG rather than BUG so merging it before the libplasma MR does not prematurely close the report.
changes: In libplasma TextFieldContextMenu.qml, replace qsTr(...) with KI18n (e.g. i18ndc("libplasma6", "@action:inmenu", ...)) because libplasma uses gettext (libplasma6.po), not Qt .qm translations, so qsTr strings will remain untranslated.

In libplasma TextFieldContextMenu.qml, move enabled and onTriggered onto the T.Action (or drop the redundant StandardKey shortcuts since TextField already handles standard editing shortcuts) so the T.Action is not left enabled when the MenuItem is disabled, null-check root.target in handlers, and disable Select All when the field is empty (enabled: (root.target?.length ?? 0) > 0).

Verify that hidden PC3.MenuSeparator instances in password/read-only fields collapse to 0 height (as done for MenuItem.qml) so they do not leave blank gaps, remove the unrelated blank-line deletion in src/declarativeimports/CMakeLists.txt, and fix the commit message typo ('seach fields').

In the plasma-workspace klipperpopup.cpp commit, change 'BUG: 525065' to 'CCBUG: 525065' (keeping 'BUG: 525065' on the libplasma MR) so landing the klipper prerequisite first does not prematurely close the bug.

reviews.text: The two-part fix is the right layer. The libplasma commit gives every PC3 TextField a context menu, so the clipboard search field and others get Paste. The klipper commit walks the transientParent chain so the Meta+V popup no longer hides when focus moves to that menu, and nullptr or unrelated focus still hides it. The screenshots show the menu working in both the tray and Meta+V popups. But TextFieldContextMenu.qml uses qsTr() for all seven labels, and libplasma has no Qt .qm catalog: its QML is translated with i18nd("libplasma6", …) via ki18n_install(po), as in PasswordField and SearchField. So the new menu would stay English for every localized user.
changes: Replace qsTr() in TextFieldContextMenu.qml with i18ndc("libplasma6", "@action:inmenu", …) (Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Delete, Select All) so the strings are extracted and translated
Optionally make the entry `line` list the actual items (Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Delete, Select All)
